name: proposal-lifecycle-review
description: Proposal lifecycle review plugin with separate proposal-review routing and proposal-anchored implementation audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Review proposals before implementation and audit implementations afterward.
interface.longDescription: Packages proposal-review-router and proposal-implementation-audit as separate first-class skills, preserving reviewer-id continuity, prior-review reuse, evidence packs, audit reports, scripts, tests, templates, rubrics, and eval coverage.
defaultPrompt: Use $proposal-lifecycle-review for the right review phase.
